shared_elements: low relief carving of figures in profile
horizontal decorative border band along the top edge
densely patterned surface texture rendering hair/fleece/feathers as repeated curls or scales
stylised eye rendered as concentric outline
justification: Both are low reliefs showing profile creatures with fleece/plumage rendered as rows of repeated stylised curls, and both are framed above by a horizontal ornamental band, which is a mild conventional correspondence. But A depicts a narrative procession of small human figures leading rams past a tree, while B is a single monumental raptor-headed creature's head and shoulder filling the whole field, so the subjects, scale relationships and compositions differ fundamentally.
